title: High Priest Gakkernog ring
summary: A sustained wave event ends with High Priest Gakkernog.
overview: A sustained wave event ends with High Priest Gakkernog.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Remain near the event trigger while clearing the waves.
The wave sequence includes pauses and changes in the enemies summoned. Use those breaks to recover.
Engage the high priest promptly when he appears; his unengaged appearance is temporary.
